lyrics:
[Intro: stomps and claps, percussive acoustic guitar, low hum]

[Verse 1: tumbling triplet rhythm, gritty and low]
I was a quiet kid with thunder in my chest
Wrote it on the inside, never handed in the test
Learned to smile at everything that hollowed me out
Carried other people's weather till I couldn't do without

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, voice rising]
I was cracked, I was cornered, I was coming apart
Every hit was a hammer on the wall of my heart

[Chorus: one shouted word, then huge distorted drums]
Break!
I was nothing till I shattered
Break!
Every crack is where the light got in
I was built by the break
The fall, the ache
Oh, let the hard days come
I was built by the break

[Verse 2: tumbling triplet rhythm, more force]
I was choking in the middle of a room that knew my name
Pulling splinters out of trophies, never happy that I came
Had a mirror I avoided, had a number I'd not call
Had a ceiling I was holding, and I let the ceiling fall

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, voice rising]
I was cracked, I was cornered, I was coming apart
Every hit was a hammer on the wall of my heart

[Chorus: one shouted word, then huge distorted drums]
Break!
I was nothing till I shattered
Break!
Every crack is where the light got in
I was built by the break
The fall, the ache
Oh, let the hard days come
I was built by the break

[Bridge: everything drops, quiet voice and one guitar]
And if you're in the middle of it
I won't say it's fine
I'll only say I've been there
And I came out mine

[Final Chorus: loudest, gang vocals, stomps on every beat]
Break!
I was nothing till I shattered
Break!
Every crack is where the light got in
I was built by the break
The fall, the ache
Oh, let the hard days come
I was built by the break

[Outro: stomps and claps alone, one last shout]
Break!
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 125 BPM, a rolling triplet feel (felt in twelve), B-flat minor. A heavy, swinging stomp. Defiant.

VOICE: Male, gritty, between baritone and tenor. Verses are delivered in fast, tumbling triplets, half rapped, low and tense. He shouts the single hook word, then sings the chorus at full strength with a rough edge. Quiet and plain in the bridge. Gang vocals on the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: Foot stomps and handclaps. A percussive acoustic guitar played with hard, muted strokes. An enormous, distorted, booming drum kit in the choruses. A growling synth bass. Low male hums. A distorted electric guitar doubling the chorus melody. Sub-bass drops.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, stomps, claps and guitar. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:35 Pre-chorus. 0:47 Chorus 1: the shout, then the drums. 1:15 Verse 2. 1:38 Pre-chorus. 1:50 Chorus 2. 2:18 Bridge, everything drops to a quiet voice and one guitar. 2:37 Final chorus with gang vocals. 3:05 Outro, stomps and claps alone, a last shout at 3:15.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s arena pop-rock built for trailers: huge, distorted, compressed drums, a dry close vocal, big silences before the hits.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first shout at 0:47 with the half-beat of silence before the drums land.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The bridge speaks to someone still in the middle of it and refuses to tell them it is fine. That restraint comes with age, and it makes the chorus more honest.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Suppression, collapse, defiance, a hand held out.
